Rust today · Apache 2.0 · Python & TypeScript planned
Application codeRust
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, QuokkaDocument)]
struct Plant {
    #[serde(rename = "_id")]
    id: QuokkaId,
    name: String,
    needs_water: bool,
}

let db = QuokkaDB::open("./data")?;
let plants = db
    .typed_collection::<Plant>("plants")
    .create_if_missing();

plants.insert_one(Plant {
    id: QuokkaId::new(),
    name: "Monstera".into(),
    needs_water: true,
})?;

let thirsty = plants.find_one(
    |plant| plant.needs_water.eq(true)
)?;
